baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future first-person plural verb at word 1 directly governs the definite collective at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A voiced summons draws agents into range, while their root supplies pushing, collision, prevention, and defensive resistance. The two-word clause therefore performs a dispatch: speech mobilizes embodied counterforce.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies both the mobilizing act and a vector of drawing the called party near.
Pushing, repelling, collision, and prevention supply the summoned collective's operative function.

changed_reading.after: An authoritative call mobilizes a force whose work is to meet, repel, and stop.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb can carry an adverse downward consequence, and its object names a force of collision and prevention.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call is not only a request for attendance. Its adverse branch allows the summons itself to bring an unwelcome consequence upon the target, with the repelling collective as the concrete form that consequence takes.

activation_trace.role: Calling down something unwelcome turns the verb into the onset of an adverse intervention.
Repelling collision gives the called-down consequence an embodied mode of action.

changed_reading.before: A group will be called to appear.
changed_reading.after: The uttered summons brings the hostile consequence into operation as a repelling collision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening joins recited speech, naming, gathering, and lordship. Against that frame, the focus call reads as efficacious sovereign speech: it identifies and gathers the force that will act, rather than merely reporting that someone will be contacted.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation establish voiced language as an enacted command at the surah's opening.
Gathering supplies the latent collective effect that the later call makes operational.
The name as designation makes the opening speech explicitly authority-bearing and identifying.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority under which verbal gathering occurs.
The focus call converts authority-bearing speech into the drawing near of executors.
The gathered collective carries the concrete function of repulsion and prevention.

structural_cues: 96:1 binds an imperative speech act to the name of the Lord, while 96:18 is another compressed finite speech-action clause.
The focus places the calling verb before the collective it mobilizes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, gathering, designation, sovereignty, and calling; I connect them by treating authorized speech as causally efficacious. A live alternative is that the opening frames revelation generally without specifying how the later summons works.

changed_reading.before: The call requests the attendance of an already defined force.
changed_reading.after: Sovereign speech itself identifies, gathers, and dispatches the force that enacts its authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context traces a reversal from original attachment through imagined independence and boundary-overflow to return. The zabaniya's repelling force can therefore be read as counter-pressure that arrests the overflow and turns false self-sufficiency back toward its limit.

activation_trace.role: Attachment and clinging supply the human starting condition of dependence.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the boundary violation to be checked.
Rising, sweeping water gives the transgression a kinetic image of overflow.
Self-sufficiency supplies the mistaken condition that drives the overflow.
Return and restoration supply the opposite direction toward which the sequence must turn.
The focus call activates and draws in the counter-pressure.
Repulsion, collision, and prevention provide the force that checks overflow and redirects it.

structural_cues: The packet orders attachment in 96:2 before self-sufficiency and overflow in 96:6-7, then explicitly states return in 96:8.
The focus threat occurs after that directional arc has been applied to the concrete blocker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependence, imagined independence, overflow, return, and repulsion; I assign the arrow by making the summoned force reverse the overflow. The agents could instead punish transgression without themselves constituting the return mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The agents arrive as an externally added punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are the counterflow to false independence, stopping an overflow and forcing its trajectory back within the authority it denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: One actor tries to stop a servant's prayer, while the questioned alternative joins command with protective restraint and the sequence culminates in divine seeing. The focus summons reverses jurisdiction: coercive prohibition is met by a higher command that dispatches preventers against the would-be preventer.

activation_trace.role: Rebuke and stopping supply the blocker’s attempted exercise of coercive authority.
Submissive worship identifies the relation and activity subjected to the blocker’s prohibition.
The specific act of worship fixes what the attempted stopping interrupts.
Command and obligation supply a rival, norm-setting direction to the blocker’s prohibition.
Protection by warding off harm gives that rival command a preventive orientation.
Divine sight supplies oversight of the contested act before enforcement is announced.
The call turns superior oversight and command into a dispatched response.
The preventers reverse the blocker’s force by applying prevention to him.

structural_cues: 96:9-12 alternates the blocking act, the worshipper, and a counter-command before 96:14 states that God sees.
The focus first-person plural summons follows the failed human claim to regulate worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, worship, counter-command, protection, sight, and dispatched prevention; I infer that the focus enforces the rightful command and protects the worship relation. A live alternative is general retribution for denial rather than a precise jurisdictional reversal.

changed_reading.before: The verse threatens a wrongdoer with superior force.
changed_reading.after: It reverses a usurped jurisdiction: the one who tried to prevent worship becomes the object of divinely dispatched prevention.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conditional failure to stop is followed by an announced grasp at a named bodily control point, then by its moral identification, and finally by the summons. The zabaniya consequently become plausible executors of a targeted restraint already specified before they are called.

activation_trace.role: Stopping and restraint define the unmet condition that triggers enforcement.
Taking by the forelock supplies the announced physical enforcement action.
The forelock as a graspable point fixes the bodily target of that action.
Falsehood supplies the first explicit qualification of the targeted forelock.
Sin and guilt supply the second qualification and make the restraint discriminating rather than indiscriminate.
The summons dispatches personnel into the already specified enforcement sequence.
Pushing, collision, and prevention fit the mechanics of seizing and immobilizing the marked target.

structural_cues: 96:15 states a condition and bodily action, 96:16 repeats and qualifies the body part, and 96:18 names the summoned collective.
The target remains singular while the enforcing object in the focus is collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-cessation, forelock seizure, moral marking, summons, and repelling force; I infer that the called collective executes the announced seizure. They could instead be a further escalation after an independently performed grasp.

changed_reading.before: The zabaniya are an undefined punitive group.
changed_reading.after: They enter as the personnel of a preannounced, targeted restraint: seize the morally marked control point and stop its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent clauses repeat the same calling root but oppose their objects. The challenger may summon his local council; the answering speaker summons a collective defined by repulsion. The focus is thus a counter-summons that exposes unequal reach and efficacy between two attempted mobilizations.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw others near supplies the challenger’s attempted mobilization.
The council or gathered company makes the challenger’s object a social assembly.
The repeated call answers the challenger in the same mobilizing register.
The answering object differs functionally: it is a collective equipped to repel and prevent.

structural_cues: 96:17 and 96:18 are adjacent clauses with the calling root at word 1 and a collective object at word 2.
The first clause challenges him to call, while the second answers with a first-person future.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two calls, a gathered council, and repelling agents; I infer that juxtaposition compares the effectiveness and jurisdiction of the two mobilizations. The sequence can also be read as simple challenge and response without a broader assembly contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse independently announces a divine reinforcement.
changed_reading.after: It is the answering half of a summons duel: a local social council is countered by a collective whose very function is to break resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah orders refusal of obedience, bodily lowering, and approach. This makes the focus dispatch a hinge rather than an endpoint: repelling force clears the blocker’s coercive claim so that the worshipper can refuse, prostrate, and draw near.

activation_trace.role: Calling draws the enforcing collective into the contested space.
Repulsion and prevention supply a clearing action against the blocker.
Obedience and compliance define the relation the worshipper is commanded to refuse.
Lowering and humility supply the worshipper’s chosen bodily orientation after coercion is rejected.
Nearness supplies the positive destination served by the focus verse’s repelling movement.

structural_cues: 96:18 directly precedes the three coordinated directives in 96:19.
The sequence moves from summoned force to refused compliance, lowered posture, and approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, repulsion, refusal, prostration, and nearness; I infer that removing coercive obstruction enables the final approach. The final directives may instead be independent reassurance rather than effects of the summons.

changed_reading.before: The punitive arrival is the scene’s endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The dispatch is a clearing action in service of worship: resistance is repelled so refusal, prostration, and approach can proceed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The paired scorpion-claw image is zoological and branch-distant, so it cannot identify the zabaniya or establish their anatomy. It remains anchored in the focus noun and gains local traction from the immediately announced forelock grasp; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory tactile configuration of seizure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2 carries a paired-claw branch, while 96:15 names grasping the forelock.

activation_trace.role: Taking by the forelock supplies the local action that a closing pair could perform.
The forelock supplies a bounded bodily hold point for the exploratory pincer image.
The call brings the force bearing this grasping configuration into range.
Paired horns or claws supply the surprising image of force closing from two sides.

changed_reading.before: A collective comes to seize the target in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the called force closes like a paired grasp around the already named bodily control point.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet’s non-dominant mapping from د ع و to د ع ع, so it is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary calling sense. The exact focus root and adjacent repeated call keep it structurally anchored; downstream prose should qualify it as a kinetic echo in which calling shades into chiding or forceful driving.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1 has a packet-supplied split mapping whose branches include forceful driving and a herding cry.

activation_trace.role: A chiding herding cry makes the challenger’s summons sound like an attempt to marshal a group.
Rough thrusting or forceful driving gives the answering call a kinetic push rather than voice alone.
The object’s own repelling force compounds the exploratory sense of driving force into motion.

changed_reading.before: We will verbally call a force.
changed_reading.after: As a split-root kinetic echo, we drive the driving force into action with a coercive cry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Distance from dwellings is a peripheral branch of ز ب ن and should not be promoted to the noun’s ordinary sense. It remains anchored by the focus noun and becomes spatially coherent beside the focus call’s drawing-near vector and 96:19’s explicit approach; downstream prose should mark it as an exploratory sorting of trajectories.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Within the focus, calling draws the summoned party near while the object’s peripheral branch carries withdrawal or distance.

activation_trace.role: Calling supplies inward movement as the enforcing collective is drawn near.
Withdrawal away from dwellings supplies the unusual outward vector assigned to the obstructing side.
Approach and nearness supply the worshipper’s explicit inward destination.

changed_reading.before: The summons adds agents to the scene.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it spatially sorts the scene: enforcement is drawn near, the obstruction is driven outward, and the worshipper approaches.

strongest_changes: The focus became the counterflow that checks imagined independence and boundary-overflow, not merely an added punishment.
The prohibition of worship became a jurisdictional reversal in which the would-be preventer is subjected to dispatched prevention.
The adjacent repeated calls became unequal mobilizations, and the final prostration and approach made repulsion a clearing action rather than the endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is only two words, yet its call-and-counterforce pairing couples tightly to the surah’s directional machinery: attachment, overflow, return, stopping, bodily seizure, rival assemblies, and opposed movements of repulsion and approach.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly links the zabaniya to the forelock threat, but it does not force the conclusion that they themselves perform the announced grasp rather than arrive as a later escalation.
The paired-claw and distance readings are useful spatial activations but remain peripheral branch images, not secure lexical identifications.
The non-dominant د ع ع mapping preserves a striking driving-cry echo, but its form distance requires explicit qualification.
